66496.recognize_zh: 視野中央的嗜中性球核分成 6 葉以上（下方一顆可數出約 6–7 葉），細胞體積也偏大，即為過度分葉嗜中性球 (hypersegmented neutrophil)，典型見於巨母紅血球性貧血 (megaloblastic anemia)。
features: Mature neutrophils with nuclei divided into six or more discrete lobes connected by thin chromatin filaments
Neutrophils appear slightly enlarged (macropolycytes) relative to surrounding red cells
Clumped mature chromatin; pale pink cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules, no toxic granulation or Döhle bodies
Red cells are normochromic, partly overlapping in stacked chains (thick-area/rouleaux-like arrangement)
Platelets present and scattered in the background
66496.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mature neutrophils with nuclear hypersegmentation; at least one neutrophil displays six or more nuclear lobes, and the neutrophils appear mildly enlarged. The cytoplasm contains normal fine granules without toxic changes. Red cells are overlapping in this field, limiting assessment of macro-ovalocytes, and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with neutrophil hypersegmentation, which should prompt evaluation for vitamin B12 or folate deficiency and exposure to antimetabolite drugs such as hydroxyurea or methotrexate.

ddx.vs: Normal neutrophils have 2–5 lobes, and hypersegmentation requires one cell with ≥6 lobes or >5% of neutrophils with 5 lobes.
The inherited form is a benign autosomal dominant trait with normal red cell indices and vitamin levels, so it is distinguished clinically and by family studies rather than morphology.
Pelger cells show the opposite change, with hyposegmented bilobed (pince-nez) or round nuclei.
MDS may show hypersegmentation but usually with hypogranular cytoplasm, pseudo-Pelger forms and cytopenias with normal B12/folate.

66368.recognize_zh: 骨髓切骨小樑之間出現多團放射狀、針狀排列並呈彩色雙折射的結晶玫瑰花團（箭頭），周圍被纖維化組織與異物巨細胞反應包圍，是草酸鹽結晶沉積 (oxalosis) 的特徵。
features: Multiple rosettes of radially arranged, needle-shaped crystals showing bright birefringence under partially polarized light (arrow)
Crystal aggregates surrounded by a rim of histiocytes and multinucleated foreign-body giant cells
Marked fibrosis replacing the intertrabecular marrow around the crystal deposits
Irregular bone trabeculae with scalloped surfaces suggesting active remodeling; osteoblast and osteoclast detail limited at this power
Residual hematopoietic marrow with fat preserved at the left edge
66368.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows multiple intertrabecular aggregates of radially arranged, needle-like crystals forming rosettes that are strongly birefringent under polarized light. The crystal deposits are surrounded by a foreign-body giant cell reaction within fibrotic stroma that replaces much of the marrow, and residual hematopoietic marrow is limited to the periphery. The adjacent trabeculae are irregular with scalloped surfaces, suggesting remodeling. Findings are consistent with calcium oxalate crystal deposition in bone marrow (oxalosis), as seen in primary hyperoxaluria or secondary hyperoxalosis with renal failure.

ddx.vs: Urate crystals are needle-shaped and strongly negatively birefringent, typically dissolve in aqueous fixation leaving amorphous tophi, and rarely involve marrow, whereas oxalate forms rosettes that persist in processed tissue.
Crystal-storing histiocytosis shows immunoglobulin crystals within histiocyte cytoplasm, which are non-birefringent or weakly birefringent and light-chain restricted.
Calcium phosphate deposits are basophilic, granular and non-birefringent, lacking radial crystal rosettes.
Infectious granulomas show necrosis and organisms on special stains without polarizable crystals.

66112.recognize_zh: 中央嗜中性球的核分成至少 6 個小葉、葉間細絲相連，屬分葉過多；周圍紅血球多為大而飽滿的卵圓形、中央淡染區不明顯（巨卵圓形紅血球），兩者合併提示巨母紅血球性變化。
features: Neutrophil with six or more small nuclear lobes connected by thin filaments
Condensed chromatin; pale pink cytoplasm with fine granules
Background red cells with many large oval, well-hemoglobinized forms (macro-ovalocytes) with reduced central pallor
Mild anisocytosis with occasional smaller round red cells; no inclusions evident
Rare platelets in field
66112.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with six or more nuclear lobes connected by thin chromatin strands and finely granular cytoplasm. The background red cells show anisocytosis with numerous large, oval, well-hemoglobinized cells with diminished central pallor, consistent with macro-ovalocytes. No red cell inclusions are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with a hypersegmented neutrophil with macro-ovalocytes, supporting megaloblastic change; vitamin B12 and folate levels should be assessed.

ddx.vs: Normal neutrophils have two to five lobes, while this cell has six or more lobes.
MDS may show macrocytosis but more often hypolobated (pseudo-Pelger-Huët) hypogranular neutrophils, with normal B12/folate.
Morphology is identical and is separated only by medication history with normal vitamin levels.

65920.recognize_zh: 中央一顆受感染紅血球明顯比周圍紅血球大且顏色變淡，內含形狀不規則、伸出偽足樣的藍色細胞質、紫紅色染色質點與金棕色瘧色素，細胞表面可見細小點狀斑點（Schüffner dots）；這是間日瘧原蟲的阿米巴樣滋養體。
features: Single infected red cell enlarged and paler than surrounding red cells
Irregular, amoeboid blue parasite cytoplasm with pseudopod-like extensions and vacuoles
Discrete magenta chromatin dot(s) within the parasite
Fine golden-brown hemozoin pigment present
Fine stippling of the host cell consistent with Schüffner dots
Background red cells normocytic without other parasites; adjacent small platelet
65920.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows a single enlarged, pale red cell containing an amoeboid trophozoite with irregular blue cytoplasm, a magenta chromatin dot and fine golden-brown pigment. The host cell shows fine red stippling consistent with Schüffner dots. Other red cells are of normal size, and no crescent gametocytes or multiple ring forms per cell are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a Plasmodium vivax growing trophozoite; parasitemia should be quantified and species confirmed (e.g., PCR or antigen test) as clinically indicated.

ddx.vs: P. ovale also enlarges the red cell and shows Schüffner dots, but the host cell is often oval with fimbriated edges and the trophozoite is compact rather than markedly amoeboid.
P. falciparum does not enlarge red cells, shows delicate rings (often multiple per cell) with Maurer clefts, and mature trophozoites are rarely seen in peripheral blood.
P. malariae infects normal or small red cells and forms compact band or basket shapes without stippling.

65856.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆比紅血球大約兩倍的淋巴球，細胞核圓、染色質濃縮，周圍有較豐富的淡藍色細胞質，內含數顆散在的粗大紫紅色嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），即大顆粒淋巴球。
features: Single lymphocyte roughly twice the diameter of a red cell with a low-to-intermediate N:C ratio
Round to slightly indented nucleus with condensed, clumped chromatin and no visible nucleolus
Abundant pale blue cytoplasm with irregular outline
Several coarse, discrete azurophilic granules scattered in the cytoplasm
Background red cells with scattered crenated forms (echinocytes, likely drying artifact) and occasional platelets
65856.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large lymphocyte with a round, mature-appearing nucleus with condensed chromatin and abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing several coarse azurophilic granules. The background red cells include scattered crenated forms, most likely artifactual. Findings are consistent with a large granular lymphocyte; a single LGL is a normal finding, and a diagnosis of LGL leukemia requires a sustained increase (typically >2 x 10^9/L) with demonstration of clonality by flow cytometry and TCR studies.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have deeply basophilic cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and usually lack discrete azurophilic granules.
Monocytes have folded or kidney-shaped nuclei with lacy chromatin and grey-blue cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules and vacuoles.
Hairy cells have oval nuclei with open chromatin and circumferential fine cytoplasmic projections without azurophilic granules.
Alder-Reilly granules are dark and present in all leukocyte lineages, including neutrophils, rather than only in a subset of lymphocytes.

65792.recognize_zh: 四格組合：A 電腦斷層見脾臟內界線清楚、低密度、無邊緣強化的囊腫（紅箭頭）；B 剖面為單房囊腔；C 為纖維性囊壁鄰接充血的紅髓；D 囊壁內襯單層扁平細胞呈 WT-1 核陽性，確認為間皮囊腫。
features: Panel A (CECT): large well-circumscribed homogeneous low-attenuation splenic cyst without wall enhancement (red arrow)
Panel B (gross): bisected spleen with a unilocular cyst at one pole with a smooth to trabeculated inner surface
Panel C (H&E): cyst wall composed of fibrous tissue adjacent to congested red pulp; lining epithelium thin and not well resolved at this magnification
Panel D (IHC): nuclear WT-1 staining in a single layer of flattened lining cells
No atypia, necrosis or parasitic elements (laminated membrane or hooklets) evident
65792.describe_en: The composite shows a contrast-enhanced CT with a large, well-demarcated, non-enhancing fluid-density lesion within the spleen, and a splenectomy specimen containing a unilocular cyst at one pole. Histologic sections show a fibrous cyst wall adjacent to congested splenic red pulp, and WT-1 immunohistochemistry highlights nuclear positivity in a single layer of flattened lining cells. No cytologic atypia, necrosis or parasitic elements are identified. Findings are consistent with a mesothelial (primary, true epithelial-lined) splenic cyst.

ddx.vs: Pseudocysts have a fibrous wall without any epithelial lining, often with hemosiderin and calcification, and lack WT-1 positive lining cells.
Epidermoid cysts are lined by squamous or transitional epithelium that is CK5/6 and p63 positive and WT-1 negative.
Hydatid cysts show an acellular laminated membrane with a germinal layer and protoscolices with hooklets.
Lymphangiomas are multilocular with endothelial lining that is D2-40/CD31 positive and proteinaceous lymph.

65728.recognize_zh: 四個視野中的嗜中性球胞質內各有一顆小而圓、深嗜鹼性、邊界清楚的單一包涵體（箭頭），大小形狀像 Howell-Jolly 小體；在服用 tacrolimus 的免疫抑制病人，最可能是 Howell-Jolly 小體樣包涵體。
features: Mature and band neutrophils with segmented to C-shaped nuclei
Single small, round, sharply defined, deeply basophilic cytoplasmic inclusion in each affected neutrophil (arrows)
Inclusion is solid and homogeneous, resembling a Howell-Jolly body, not a stippled cluster
Pale grey-blue cytoplasm with sparse granulation
Background red cells normocytic without significant poikilocytosis; scattered platelets
65728.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils, including band forms, each containing a single small, round, sharply circumscribed and deeply basophilic cytoplasmic inclusion resembling a Howell-Jolly body. The inclusions are homogeneous rather than granular or morula-like, and no extracellular organisms are seen. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable in these fields. In an immunosuppressed transplant recipient on tacrolimus, the findings are most consistent with Howell-Jolly body-like neutrophil inclusions, after exclusion of Anaplasma/Ehrlichia infection.

ddx.vs: Morulae are larger, stippled mulberry-like clusters of organisms, and PCR for Anaplasma is positive.
Dohle bodies are pale blue, ill-defined, often peripheral rough ER remnants, not dark, round, sharply defined inclusions.
An overlying platelet shows granular purple texture with a pale hyalomere and lies in a different focal plane.
Bacteria appear as multiple cocci or rods and yeasts show a clear halo and budding, rather than a single solid chromatin-like dot.

65664.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆組織球的細胞質內塞滿數十到上百個大小一致（約 2–4 µm）的小卵圓形酵母菌，每個都有偏一側的深染核點與周圍透明暈（pseudocapsule），部分已散出細胞外；這種密集小型帶暈酵母即為組織胞漿菌。
features: Histiocyte distended by numerous small uniform oval yeast forms
Yeasts approximately 2-4 um with a dark crescentic or eccentric nucleus and a surrounding clear halo
Some organisms spilling outside the macrophage
No kinetoplast visible within organisms
Surrounding marrow cells include lymphocytes, erythroid precursors, and myeloid cells in a thick red-cell-rich background
65664.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage packed with numerous small, uniform, oval intracellular yeasts measuring approximately 2 to 4 um, each with an eccentric dark-staining nucleus and a surrounding clear halo, with some organisms released extracellularly. No kinetoplasts are identified. The background contains mixed hematopoietic cells in a thick area of the smear. Findings are consistent with Histoplasma capsulatum infection of the bone marrow; confirmation by GMS or PAS staining, fungal culture, or urine/serum Histoplasma antigen is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have both a nucleus and a rod-shaped kinetoplast and lack a clear halo, and are GMS-negative.
Talaromyces yeasts are more elongated and divide by fission with a central transverse septum rather than budding.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped without a halo or cell wall and are GMS-negative.
Cryptococcus is larger and more variable in size with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule and narrow-based budding.

65536.recognize_zh: E-cadherin 免疫染色中，只有少數散在、體積很大的細胞呈棕色膜狀陽性，細胞核圓且大、染色質淡；背景骨髓細胞很少且沒有成群的正常紅血球前驅細胞。這符合 parvovirus B19 造成純紅血球再生不良時的巨大原紅血球（giant proerythroblast）。
features: Scattered, isolated very large cells (several times the size of surrounding nuclei) with membranous/cytoplasmic E-cadherin positivity
Large round to oval nuclei with pale, open chromatin inside a rim of positive cytoplasm
Absence of clusters of smaller E-cadherin-positive maturing erythroid precursors
Hypocellular background composed mainly of granulocytic nuclei, stromal cells and abundant fat spaces
E-cadherin marks early erythroid precursors, confirming the erythroid lineage of the giant cells
65536.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy section stained for E-cadherin by immunohistochemistry shows a hypocellular marrow with prominent fat and a residual population of granulocytic and stromal cells. Scattered single very large cells with large round nuclei and open chromatin show membranous and cytoplasmic E-cadherin staining, identifying them as early erythroid precursors. Normal erythroid islands composed of smaller, maturing E-cadherin-positive precursors are absent. Findings are consistent with giant proerythroblasts of parvovirus B19 infection with pure red cell aplasia.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are E-cadherin negative and CD61/CD42b positive, with lobulated rather than round single nuclei.
Erythroid leukemia shows sheets of E-cadherin-positive immature erythroid cells (often p53-positive) rather than rare isolated giant proerythroblasts in a hypocellular marrow.
Carcinoma cells are also E-cadherin positive but form cohesive clusters and are keratin positive, whereas proerythroblasts are keratin negative and CD71/glycophorin positive.
Megaloblastic anemia shows increased, maturing erythroid precursors at all stages rather than absent maturation with only isolated giant pronormoblasts.

65344.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片（H&E）中大量組織球聚集成片，細胞質淡而泡沫狀，裡面塞滿許多約 2–4 µm 的深色小點狀體，這些即細胞內無鞭毛體（amastigotes，Leishman-Donovan bodies），背景夾雜淋巴球與漿細胞，符合內臟利什曼原蟲病。
features: Sheets of enlarged histiocytes with abundant pale, vacuolated cytoplasm replacing marrow space
Numerous tiny (2–4 µm) basophilic dot-like intracytoplasmic organisms filling histiocyte cytoplasm
Organism internal detail (nucleus and kinetoplast) not resolvable on H&E at this magnification
Admixed small lymphocytes and plasma cells with scattered eosinophilic stromal material
Normal trilineage hematopoiesis not evident in this field
65344.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows extensive infiltration by sheets of histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm, admixed with small lymphocytes and plasma cells. At higher magnification the histiocytes contain numerous tiny, round, basophilic intracytoplasmic bodies measuring approximately 2–4 µm. The kinetoplast cannot be resolved on this H&E section, so correlation with a Giemsa-stained aspirate or touch preparation, serology, or PCR is advised. Findings are consistent with Leishman-Donovan bodies of visceral leishmaniasis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts show a clear halo artifact, lack a kinetoplast, and stain with GMS and PAS, whereas Leishmania amastigotes are GMS-negative and have a bar-like kinetoplast on Giemsa.
T. marneffei yeasts divide by central transverse septation and are GMS-positive, lacking the nucleus-plus-kinetoplast pattern of amastigotes.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescentic, lack a kinetoplast and are confirmed by Toxoplasma immunohistochemistry.
Storage cells have fibrillary 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm without discrete punctate organisms.

65088.recognize_zh: 10 倍下濾泡中央是一個很小、粉紅玻璃樣變的萎縮生發中心，內含少數核大淡染的濾泡樹突細胞與內皮細胞，外圍小淋巴球層層同心排列成明顯的洋蔥皮狀外套區，濾泡間有增生的血管；典型的透明血管型 Castleman 病濾泡。
features: Small central regressed germinal center with hyalinized eosinophilic stroma
Germinal center contains a few follicular dendritic cells with enlarged vesicular nuclei and plump endothelial cells
Strikingly concentric onion-skin layering of small mature mantle lymphocytes
Interfollicular areas with increased small vessels lined by plump endothelial cells
Absence of tingible-body macrophages and atypical large cells
65088.describe_en: Lymph node section at intermediate power shows a follicle with a small, hyalinized, lymphocyte-depleted germinal center containing a few follicular dendritic cells with enlarged vesicular nuclei and endothelial cells. The germinal center is encircled by an expanded mantle zone of small mature lymphocytes arranged in concentric onion-skin layers. The interfollicular stroma is highly vascular with plump endothelial cells. Findings are consistent with a regressed germinal center with dysplastic follicular dendritic cells in unicentric hyaline-vascular Castleman disease.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: MCL mantles consist of monotonous slightly irregular cyclin D1+/CD5+ cells, whereas these mantle lymphocytes are polyclonal and the germinal center is hyalinized.
iMCD usually has sheet-like interfollicular plasmacytosis and systemic inflammatory features with multiple enlarged node stations, rather than a solitary hyaline-vascular lesion.
Reactive follicles show large active germinal centers with centroblasts, mitoses and tingible-body macrophages and a thin polarized mantle.

65024.recognize_zh: 這是多面板整合圖：左上 G-banding 核型 46,XY,t(1;11)(q21;q23)[25]，框出 der(1) 與 der(11)；左下 metaphase FISH 以 KMT2A 分離探針顯示 1F1R1G 訊號，確認 KMT2A 重排；右側 A–D 為血液與骨髓抹片中的母細胞，E–F 為富含母細胞的高細胞性骨髓切片。診斷的關鍵在核型與 FISH，而非單看形態。
features: G-banded karyogram 46,XY,t(1;11)(q21;q23)[25] with der(1) and der(11) boxed with ideograms
Metaphase and interphase FISH with KMT2A break-apart probe showing 1F1R1G pattern, split signals localized to der(1) and der(11)
Panel A (PB): neutrophil-sized cell reported as a doughnut (ring) nucleus, detail limited at this resolution
Panels B-D (PB and BM aspirate): large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Panels E-F (BM biopsy, H&E): hypercellular marrow with sheets of immature cells replacing normal hematopoiesis
65024.describe_en: This composite figure combines cytogenetic, FISH and morphologic panels. The G-banded karyotype shows 46,XY,t(1;11)(q21;q23) in all 25 metaphases, and metaphase FISH with a KMT2A break-apart probe demonstrates a 1 fusion, 1 red, 1 green pattern with split signals on der(1) and der(11), confirming KMT2A rearrangement. Peripheral blood and bone marrow aspirate panels show large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm, and a cell with a ring-shaped nucleus is indicated in panel A, although small panel size limits cytologic detail. The trephine sections show a hypercellular marrow effaced by blasts. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with KMT2A::MLLT11 rearrangement, an adverse-risk genetic group under ELN 2022.

ddx.vs: t(9;11) is the most common KMT2A partner and is distinguished only by the partner chromosome on karyotype or fusion transcript testing, not by morphology.

ddx.dx: AML with 11q23 deletion or partial tandem duplication of KMT2A
ddx.vs: KMT2A-PTD is not detected by break-apart FISH or karyotype and requires molecular testing, whereas a balanced translocation with split signals indicates true rearrangement.
Recurrent KMT2A rearrangement defines AML regardless of blast count in WHO 5th edition, and the marrow here is effaced by blasts.
KMT2A rearrangements are frequent after topoisomerase II inhibitors, so prior cytotoxic exposure must be excluded clinically rather than morphologically.

65152.recognize_zh: 與旁邊的小淋巴球相比，右側細胞團體積巨大，細胞質內大型淡染空泡把深染細胞核擠成新月形貼邊（印戒細胞）；左側另有一顆大型、細胞質濃密深染的圓形腫瘤細胞。
features: Cluster of very large atypical cells, many times the diameter of an adjacent small lymphocyte
Large clear to pale intracytoplasmic vacuoles displacing nuclei into peripheral crescents (signet ring cells)
Separate large round cell with dense, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and indistinct overlapping nucleus
Hyperchromatic nuclei with smooth contours; nucleoli obscured by dense staining
Background with a few small lymphocytes and scant debris
65152.describe_en: Cytospin of ascitic fluid shows large atypical cells that dwarf the background small lymphocytes. On the right, a cohesive cluster of cells contains large pale intracytoplasmic vacuoles that compress hyperchromatic nuclei into crescents at the cell edge, giving a signet ring configuration; on the left, a single large round cell with dense basophilic cytoplasm is present. Dense staining obscures nucleoli. Findings are consistent with metastatic adenocarcinoma with signet ring cell differentiation; the primary site requires correlation with cell block immunocytochemistry and imaging.

ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells are smaller, have centrally placed nuclei and two-tone cytoplasm with a lacy edge, and are calretinin/WT1 positive, lacking mucin vacuoles that indent the nucleus.
Lobular carcinoma cells are usually smaller and arranged singly or in chains with targetoid intracytoplasmic lumina, and are GATA3/ER positive with E-cadherin loss.
Lymphoma cells are discohesive with scant cytoplasm and lymphoglandular bodies in the background, and are CD45 positive and keratin negative.

64320.recognize_zh: 粗針切片中大型異型淋巴細胞呈瀰漫片狀浸潤，伴出血與壞死；多條血管壁被深藍紫色的 DNA 物質包覆（Azzopardi 現象），Ki-67 染色（D）顯示許多細胞核陽性。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells effacing the core biopsy
Neoplastic cells with round to oval nuclei, open chromatin and moderate to abundant cytoplasm (panel C)
Basophilic hematoxylin-staining DNA encrustation of small vessel walls (Azzopardi phenomenon) in panels A-C
Areas of hemorrhage and eosinophilic necrosis between cellular zones
Ki-67 IHC (panel D) with a high proliferation fraction, roughly half of cells positive
Crush artifact and small-lymphocyte-rich area at one edge of panel A
64320.describe_en: Core biopsies of lymph node show diffuse effacement by sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, vesicular chromatin and moderate cytoplasm, admixed with areas of hemorrhage and necrosis. Numerous small vessels show basophilic encrustation of their walls by nuclear DNA released from necrotic tumor cells (Azzopardi phenomenon). Ki-67 immunostain highlights a high proliferation index (approximately 50%). In the context of CD20+, CD5+, BCL6+, MUM1+ immunophenotype, findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, CD5-positive, non-germinal center type.

ddx.vs: Azzopardi effect is classic for small cell carcinoma, but those cells are small with nuclear molding, salt-and-pepper chromatin and keratin/INSM1 positivity, whereas these cells are large, CD45+/CD20+ and keratin-negative.
Both can be CD5+, but mantle cell lymphoma expresses cyclin D1 and SOX11, which were negative here.
Richter transformation arises with a background CLL/SLL component (CD5+/CD23+ small cells) and a clinical history of CLL, which were not present.
ALCL shows hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and strong uniform CD30 with T-cell or null phenotype, rather than CD20+ B cells.

64448.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片滿布中至大型母細胞（核質比高、染色質細緻、細胞質少且嗜鹼性）；流式細胞儀示 CD34+、CD19+、CD10+ 的 B 淋巴母細胞；間期 FISH 顯示 BCL2-IGH 融合訊號，MYC 斷裂探針卻呈陰性，直到中期 FISH 以 MYC-IGH 雙融合探針才看到隱藏的 MYC 易位。
features: Panel A: marrow aspirate replaced by medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules; a residual neutrophil and red cells in background
Panel B: blast gate expressing CD34, HLA-DR, CD19 and CD10
Panel C: interphase BCL2-IGH dual-fusion FISH with 2 fusion signals (2F2G1R pattern) indicating t(14;18)
Panel D: MYC break-apart probe with intact fused signals (falsely negative)
Panel E: metaphase MYC-IGH dual-fusion FISH localizing fusion signals to der(8) and der(14)
64448.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate is extensively replaced by medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous to small nucleoli and scant basophilic, agranular cytoplasm. Flow cytometry shows the blasts to express CD34, HLA-DR, CD19 and CD10, consistent with B-lymphoblasts. Interphase FISH demonstrates IGH::BCL2 fusion, while the MYC break-apart probe shows no split signal; metaphase FISH with an MYC-IGH dual-fusion probe reveals a cryptic MYC-IGH translocation. Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia with concurrent MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, a high-risk genetic combination.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements (leukemic phase)
ddx.vs: HGBL cells are usually TdT-negative, CD34-negative mature B cells with surface light chain, whereas these blasts are CD34+/TdT+ with an IKZF1 deletion.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm, are sIg+/CD34-/TdT- and carry MYC rearrangement without BCL2 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Transformed follicular lymphoma with blastoid morphology
ddx.vs: Transformed FL shows a prior or concurrent FL component and mature B-cell phenotype without CD34/TdT expression.
AML blasts may look identical but lack CD19/CD10/cCD79a and express myeloid markers such as CD13/CD33/CD117.

64448.stain: Wright-Giemsa; flow; FISH: BCL2-IGH, MYC, MYC-IGH

64384.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎被成片的大型原紅血球（proerythroblast）佔滿：核圓、染色質細緻、可見核仁，細胞質深藍色並帶有空泡與泡狀突起，缺乏成熟的顆粒球系，符合純紅血球型急性白血病。
features: Sheets of large immature cells replacing normal marrow elements
Round, central to eccentric nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and one or more nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm, often with a paler perinuclear zone
Cytoplasmic vacuoles and blebs/pseudopod-like projections in several cells
Occasional binucleate forms; few maturing granulocytes present
64384.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular population dominated by sheets of large proerythroblast-like cells with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, one or more nucleoli and deeply basophilic, variably vacuolated cytoplasm with occasional blebs. Binucleate forms are present, and normal granulocytic maturation is markedly reduced. Findings are consistent with acute erythroid leukemia (pure erythroid leukemia), to be confirmed by immunophenotyping (E-cadherin, CD71, glycophorin A) and a differential showing more than 80% erythroid cells with at least 30% proerythroblasts.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic erythropoiesis shows a full maturation spectrum with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant metamyelocytes, rather than a monotonous arrest at the proerythroblast stage, and corrects with B12/folate.
Megakaryoblasts also have basophilic blebbed cytoplasm, but they express CD41/CD61 and are negative for erythroid markers.
Parvovirus shows scattered giant proerythroblasts with glassy intranuclear inclusions against erythroid aplasia, not sheets of blasts.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm too, but they are smaller with clumped chromatin and are CD19/CD10/MYC-positive.

64128.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見一群大型巨噬細胞，細胞質大量、淡藍色、布滿細小均一空泡呈泡沫狀，核小而偏位，成簇分布，為儲積症的泡沫細胞（如 Niemann-Pick）。
features: Clusters of very large macrophages many times the size of adjacent hematopoietic cells
Abundant pale blue cytoplasm filled with numerous fine, uniform vacuoles (foamy/mulberry appearance)
Small, round to irregular eccentric nuclei with condensed chromatin
No fibrillary striations or blue-green granules in the cytoplasm
Background of maturing erythroid and myeloid precursors and red cells
64128.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters of large histiocytes with abundant pale blue cytoplasm distended by numerous fine uniform vacuoles, giving a foamy appearance, and small eccentric nuclei. The cytoplasm lacks the fibrillary striations of Gaucher cells and the coarse blue-green granules of sea-blue histiocytes. The background contains maturing erythroid and myeloid precursors. Findings are consistent with foamy storage histiocytes, suggestive of Niemann-Pick disease; enzymatic and molecular confirmation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillary 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than discrete small vacuoles and show glucocerebrosidase deficiency.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain granular blue-green ceroid pigment on Romanowsky stain rather than clear uniform vacuoles.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher or foamy macrophages of high cell turnover (CML, thalassemia, myeloma)
ddx.vs: Secondary foamy macrophages occur sporadically with an underlying disorder evident elsewhere in the marrow, and enzyme studies are normal.
Hemophagocytes contain engulfed red cells, platelets, or nucleated cells rather than uniform lipid vacuoles.

64064.recognize_zh: 單顆母細胞核質比高、染色質細緻，細胞核右上方有一個清楚的淡染凹陷，使核呈杯狀（cup-shaped，魚嘴樣）；標題所述 Auer 小體在此解析度下僅見凹陷區可疑的淡線狀構造，不易確認。
features: Single intermediate-to-large blast, roughly 1.5–2 times a red cell diameter
High N:C ratio with finely dispersed chromatin
Prominent pale cup-shaped nuclear invagination at one pole (fish-mouth appearance), occupying well over a quarter of the nuclear diameter
Scant pale cytoplasm; a possible faint linear inclusion in the invagination, but a definite Auer rod is not clearly resolved
Background normochromic red cells without other nucleated cells in field; image slightly out of focus
64064.describe_en: Smear shows a single blast with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and a prominent pale cup-shaped nuclear invagination giving a fish-mouth appearance. The surrounding cytoplasm is scant, and a definite Auer rod cannot be confidently identified at this focus and resolution, although a faint linear structure may be present within the invagination. No other nucleated cells are in the field. Findings are consistent with a cup-like blast, a morphology associated with AML with NPM1 mutation and/or FLT3-ITD; molecular testing is required for classification.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL shows bilobed or reniform folded nuclei with fine granules and occasional faggot cells, and PML::RARA testing separates it.
Monocytic cells have folded or convoluted nuclei with more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm rather than a sharply demarcated clear invagination.
Cup-like invaginations can rarely be seen in ALL, and the absence of a convincing Auer rod means immunophenotyping (MPO, cCD3, CD19) is needed to assign lineage.

ddx.dx: Artifactual nuclear indentation from overlying red cell
ddx.vs: An overlying red cell produces a pink-tinged circular overlap rather than a clear pale invagination within the nucleus.

64000.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片背景中散見數條細長、弧形或針狀、淡藍灰色的細胞外結晶，最長可橫跨數個紅血球，旁邊紅血球有輕度成串（rouleaux），在漿細胞白血病情境下為免疫球蛋白結晶。
features: Several extracellular elongated, curved, needle- to sickle-shaped pale blue-gray crystals spanning multiple red cell diameters
Some crystals branch or fragment (right field)
Mild rouleaux formation and occasional stacked red cells
Scattered red cells with small dark punctate dots, possibly stain precipitate or overlying platelets
No nucleated cells in this field
64000.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several extracellular, elongated, curved and needle-shaped pale blue-gray crystalline structures measuring several red cell diameters in length, some with branching or fragmented ends. Red cells show mild rouleaux formation, and small dark punctate dots overlie some red cells, likely representing precipitate. No nucleated cells are present in this field. In a patient with plasma cell leukemia, these structures are consistent with extracellular immunoglobulin (paraprotein) crystals, which may precipitate on cooling (cryocrystalglobulin).

ddx.vs: Cholesterol crystals are flat notched rhomboid plates rather than curved needles, and drug crystals require a medication history; composition may need special studies.
Precipitate is granular and fibers are refractile with uneven thickness and lie on a different focal plane, whereas these crystals are smooth, tapered, and uniformly stained.
Microorganisms show segmented or beaded morphology, septation, or budding and are typically intracellular in neutrophils in sepsis.
HbC crystals are dense, blunt-ended hexagonal rods located inside red cells, not long extracellular pale blue needles.

63808.recognize_zh: PAX5 核染色中，許多大型、核仁明顯輪廓的腫瘤細胞核呈強且均勻的棕色核陽性，強度與周圍陰性細胞對比清楚；古典何杰金淋巴瘤的 RS 細胞通常只有弱 PAX5，這種強陽性支持 B 細胞來源的灰區淋巴瘤。
features: Numerous large nuclei with strong, uniform nuclear PAX5 positivity
Positive nuclei are larger than background cells and irregularly clustered
Background of PAX5-negative cells with blue hematoxylin counterstain
Nuclear (not cytoplasmic) staining pattern confirms specificity
63808.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for PAX5 on a tissue biopsy shows numerous large atypical cells with strong nuclear PAX5 expression, distributed in clusters within a background of PAX5-negative cells. The strong intensity of PAX5 in the large neoplastic cells supports B-cell derivation and is unusual for classical Hodgkin lymphoma, in which Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are characteristically dim PAX5 positive. In conjunction with CD45 positivity and the morphology, the findings support B-cell lymphoma with features intermediate between DLBCL and classical Hodgkin lymphoma (gray zone lymphoma).

ddx.vs: HRS cells show weak PAX5 compared with the bright staining of reactive small B cells, whereas here the large cells are strongly positive.
DLBCL/PMBL also show strong PAX5 but have uniform CD20, OCT2, BOB1 and lack CD15 and cHL-like morphology.
LP cells are strongly PAX5/CD20+ but CD30-/CD15- and sit in nodules rich in small B cells with PD1+ T-cell rosettes.

63744.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖：CD19+ 淋巴球（藍色）CD5 陰性、CD10 陰性、CD20 強陽性，且 kappa/lambda 圖上幾乎全部落在 kappa 象限，呈現 kappa 輕鏈限制性；CD5-/CD10- 單株 B 細胞符合淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤的免疫表型。
features: Multi-panel flow cytometry dot plots on the lymphocyte gate
CD19+ B-cell population (blue) with moderate-bright CD45
B cells negative for CD5 (CD19+CD5+ gate essentially empty) and negative for CD10
Bright CD20 expression on CD19+ cells
Kappa-restricted surface light chain with no lambda-positive B-cell population
63744.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the lymphocyte gate identifies a CD19-positive B-cell population with bright CD20 expression. The B cells lack CD5 and CD10, as shown by essentially empty CD19+CD5+ and CD10+ gates. Surface light-chain analysis shows kappa restriction with no appreciable lambda-positive B cells. These findings indicate a monotypic CD5-negative, CD10-negative B-cell population, which in the context of an IgM paraprotein, lymphoplasmacytic marrow infiltrate and MYD88 L265P is consistent with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma. A plasma-cell gate (CD38/CD138) would further characterize the clonal plasmacytic component.

ddx.vs: MZL shares the CD5-/CD10- kappa- or lambda-restricted phenotype, so distinction needs clinicopathologic and MYD88 correlation.
CLL is CD5+/CD23+ with dim CD20 and dim light chain, unlike this CD5-negative bright CD20 population.
MCL is typically CD5+ and CD23- with cyclin D1 positivity.
FL B cells are CD10 positive, whereas these are CD10 negative.

63680.recognize_zh: 兩顆大型淋巴球，細胞質豐富、淡染，內含少量細小的嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），這是大顆粒淋巴球（large granular lymphocytes）；右側細胞核呈分葉狀，屬少見的核型變化。
features: Two large lymphocytes with abundant pale, clear to faintly pink cytoplasm
Few fine to small azurophilic granules scattered in the cytoplasm
Left cell: irregular, indented nucleus with condensed, clumped chromatin
Right cell: lobulated, clover-like nucleus with mature chromatin
No nucleoli; background red cells normochromic without significant poikilocytosis
63680.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two large lymphocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm containing a few fine azurophilic granules, consistent with large granular lymphocytes. The nuclei have mature, condensed chromatin without nucleoli; one is irregular and indented and the other is lobulated. Background red cells are unremarkable and no cytopenia-related changes are evident in this field. In the setting of a persistent lymphocytosis with a clonal CD3+CD4+CD56+CD57+ T-cell population, findings are consistent with T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia (CD4+ variant); TCR gene rearrangement and STAT3 mutation analysis support the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive LGLs are morphologically identical, so persistence beyond 6 months, clonal TCR rearrangement and STAT3/STAT5B mutation are needed to distinguish them.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-LGL proliferations are surface CD3 negative and CD16/CD56 positive without TCR rearrangement, whereas these cells are CD3 positive T cells.
ATLL flower cells have hyperlobated nuclei with scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm, are CD4+CD25+ and CD7 negative, and are associated with HTLV-1.
Monocytes have gray-blue cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules and vacuoles, folded nuclei with lacy chromatin, and are CD14 positive.

63552.recognize_zh: 這張是腦部 MRI 顯影後軸切面：雙側視丘／基底核與左側顳枕葉可見多顆邊緣環狀增強、中心低訊號的病灶，屬多發性環狀增強病灶（ring-enhancing lesions），配合肝膿瘍培養出 Nocardia 支持 Nocardia 腦膿瘍。
features: Axial post-contrast T1-weighted (3D BRAVO) MRI of the brain
At least three to four ring-enhancing lesions: two adjacent lesions in the deep gray matter/thalami and one in the left temporo-occipital region near the lateral ventricle
Lesions show thin, smooth, complete rims of enhancement with central non-enhancing (hypointense) cores
Mild surrounding hypointensity suggestive of perilesional edema; no marked midline shift
Non-morphologic radiology image; imaging alone cannot establish the organism
63552.describe_en: Axial contrast-enhanced T1-weighted MRI of the brain demonstrates multiple ring-enhancing lesions, including two in the deep gray matter near the thalami and one in the left posterior temporal/occipital region adjacent to the lateral ventricle. The lesions have thin, relatively smooth enhancing rims with central non-enhancing cores and mild surrounding edema, without significant mass effect or midline shift on this slice. Ring enhancement is nonspecific and encompasses abscess, toxoplasmosis, lymphoma and metastasis; diffusion-weighted imaging and microbiologic sampling are needed for specificity. In the context of Nocardia identified from a liver abscess, the findings are suggestive of disseminated nocardiosis with brain abscesses.

ddx.vs: Toxoplasma lesions favor the basal ganglia in profoundly immunosuppressed patients and may show an eccentric target sign, and are distinguished by serology, PCR and response to empiric therapy rather than imaging alone.

Lymphoma typically shows solid homogeneous enhancement with restricted diffusion of the solid component, periventricular location and CSF or biopsy evidence of clonal B cells, whereas abscess cavities show central restricted diffusion.
Metastases usually lie at the gray-white junction with thick irregular rims and disproportionate edema, and lack central diffusion restriction.
Angioinvasive fungal abscesses are often hemorrhagic with susceptibility artifact and vascular territory infarction; tissue culture separates them.

63488.recognize_zh: 四格圖中，大型組織球細胞質呈淡色、細纖維狀，像皺摺的衛生紙（wrinkled tissue paper）；B 格切片中成片出現，C–D 格普魯士藍（Prussian blue）染色見整個細胞質瀰漫藍染且帶條紋，符合戈謝氏病（Gaucher disease）細胞。
features: A: aspirate smear with large histiocytes having abundant pale, finely striated cytoplasm among red cells and hematopoietic precursors
B: marrow section with sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale pink fibrillar cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei
C: Prussian blue stain at lower power showing numerous blue-staining histiocytes in the particle
D: single Gaucher cell with crumpled tissue-paper, striated cytoplasm diffusely stained blue by Prussian blue
No carcinoma clusters or granulomas identified
63488.describe_en: This four-panel composite shows bone marrow involvement by storage histiocytes. The aspirate smear (A) contains large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely striated cytoplasm, and the biopsy section (B) shows sheets of similar cells with pale pink fibrillar cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei, stated to be PAS positive. Prussian blue stains (C-D) show diffuse, streaky blue staining of the histiocyte cytoplasm with the characteristic crumpled tissue-paper texture, rather than discrete hemosiderin granules. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells; confirmation by glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay or GBA1 genetic testing is required.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells are morphologically similar, so enzyme activity and the underlying disease must be assessed; mycobacteria are detected with AFB stain and CML with BCR::ABL1.
Niemann-Pick cells have foamy, vacuolated bubbly cytoplasm and sea-blue granules rather than fibrillar striated cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma (e.g., signet ring or clear cell)
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with nuclear atypia and are keratin positive, whereas Gaucher cells are CD68 positive histiocytes with bland nuclei.
Siderophages contain coarse discrete blue granules of hemosiderin, whereas Gaucher cells show diffuse, streaky staining of the whole cytoplasm.

63296.recognize_zh: 淋巴球閘門的 CD2/CD7 散佈圖中，有一群 CD2 強陽性但 CD7 陰性（約 10^3 以下）的藍色 T 細胞，與 CD2+CD7+ 的正常 T 細胞（紅色）明顯分開；T 細胞失去 CD7 是淋巴球型嗜酸性球增多症（lymphocytic variant HES）中異常 T 細胞族群的線索。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot gated on lymphocytes: CD7-APC700 (x-axis) versus CD2-PC7 (y-axis)
Large discrete blue population with bright CD2 and absent CD7 expression, with a tail extending into the CD7-positive range
Normal T cells (red) are CD2-positive and CD7-positive
Orange events with variable, partly dim CD2 and positive CD7 (likely NK cells)
Purple CD2-negative, CD7-negative events consistent with B cells
63296.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the lymphocyte gate (CD7 versus CD2) shows a prominent T-cell population with bright CD2 and loss of CD7 (blue), distinct from the residual CD2+CD7+ normal T cells (red). NK cells (orange) and CD2-/CD7- B cells (purple) are also present. In the context of hypereosinophilia and the accompanying CD3/CD5 and CD4/CD8 plots of this case, the CD7-negative T cells represent the aberrant (typically CD3-negative, CD4-positive) T-cell clone. Findings are consistent with the lymphocytic variant of hypereosinophilic syndrome; T-cell receptor gene rearrangement studies are recommended to document clonality.

ddx.dx: Reactive expansion of CD7-negative memory T cells
ddx.vs: Small CD4+CD7- subsets occur in reactive states and aging, but they retain surface CD3 and do not form a large discrete population with other antigen aberrancies.
Also shows CD4+CD7- (often CD26-) T cells, but is defined by erythroderma or skin lesions and circulating cerebriform Sezary cells rather than isolated hypereosinophilia with a CD3- clone.
T-PLL is typically CD7 bright with marked lymphocytosis of prolymphocytes and TCL1 overexpression, unlike the CD7-negative clone here.

63232.recognize_zh: 胸部增強電腦斷層（CT）軸切面上，黃色箭頭圈出前／右側縱膈腔一個邊界清楚、分葉狀的大腫塊，顯影明顯且不均勻，推擠但未侵犯大血管；富血管的孤立縱膈淋巴結腫塊是 unicentric Castleman 病的典型影像表現。
features: Axial contrast-enhanced CT of the thorax at the level of the great vessels
Large, well-defined, lobulated anterior/right mediastinal mass (yellow arrows)
Intense, mildly heterogeneous enhancement approaching vascular density
Mass abuts and displaces adjacent vessels without obvious invasion or encasement
No pleural effusion or pulmonary nodule evident on this single slice
63232.describe_en: Axial contrast-enhanced CT of the chest demonstrates a large, well-circumscribed, lobulated mass in the anterior and right mediastinum, outlined by yellow arrows. The mass shows intense, mildly heterogeneous contrast enhancement and abuts the adjacent great vessels without definite invasion. No pleural effusion is seen on this slice. A solitary, hypervascular, well-defined mediastinal mass is compatible with unicentric (hyaline-vascular) Castleman disease; tissue diagnosis is required to exclude lymphoma and other mediastinal neoplasms.

ddx.dx: Mediastinal lymphoma (e.g., primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma usually enhances only mildly, tends to encase vessels and may be necrotic, whereas hyaline-vascular Castleman disease is avidly enhancing; biopsy is decisive.
Thymoma is an anterior mediastinal soft-tissue mass with moderate enhancement rather than near-vascular enhancement, and histology shows thymic epithelium.
Paraganglioma is also hypervascular but usually arises in the paravertebral/aortopulmonary region and is confirmed by catecholamine studies and chromogranin/synaptophysin-positive zellballen.
Germ cell tumors often contain fat, calcification or cystic components and may have elevated AFP/beta-hCG, unlike the homogeneous hypervascular Castleman mass.

63168.recognize_zh: 分葉嗜中性球的細胞質內有一個小圓形、藍色中心並帶清楚外圈與暈圈的酵母菌體，大小約一個血小板，是被吞噬的念珠菌（Candida）酵母。
features: Segmented neutrophil containing a single small round intracytoplasmic yeast form
Yeast shows a basophilic centre, distinct wall and surrounding clear halo
Neutrophil cytoplasm finely granular with mild toxic-appearing granulation
Adjacent large dense basophilic lymphoid cell and a pale large platelet/granular cell nearby
Crowded background red cells; no extracellular budding yeasts or pseudohyphae visible
63168.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil containing a small round intracytoplasmic yeast form with a basophilic centre, defined wall and clear surrounding halo. The neutrophil cytoplasm is finely granular. No extracellular budding yeasts or pseudohyphae are seen in this field, and the remaining leukocytes do not contain organisms. Findings are consistent with fungemia with phagocytosed yeast, in keeping with Candida infection; correlation with blood cultures is required.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma typically forms multiple small uniform intracellular yeasts, more often in monocytes, whereas a single larger yeast is seen here; culture confirms species.
Superimposed platelets show purple granulomere without a refractile wall or halo and are in a different focal plane.
Dohle bodies are ill-defined pale blue patches and vacuoles are empty spaces, neither having a round stained body with a defined wall.
Anaplasma morulae are irregular stippled basophilic clusters of tiny organisms without a refractile wall or halo.

63104.recognize_zh: CD8 在下方正常紅髓的脾竇內襯細胞（littoral cells）呈強膜狀陽性，但上方病灶的吻合血管腔內襯細胞不著色、只見散在 CD8 陽性小淋巴球；病灶內襯細胞失去 CD8 表現是認出 littoral cell angioma 的線索。
features: Sharp contrast between CD8-positive native splenic sinus lining cells (lower field) and the lesion (upper field)
Normal red pulp sinusoids outlined by strong membranous CD8 staining in a ring-like, anastomosing pattern
Lesional vascular channels lack CD8 staining of their lining cells
Scattered CD8-positive small lymphocytes within the lesion
Lesion shows pale, loosely arranged channels with focal hemorrhage and fibrous areas
63104.describe_en: Low-power CD8 immunostain of spleen shows a well-demarcated vascular lesion adjacent to uninvolved red pulp. The native splenic sinusoids in the adjacent red pulp are outlined by strong CD8 staining of the littoral lining cells, whereas the anastomosing channels of the lesion are negative, with only scattered CD8-positive T cells present. Loss of CD8 in the lesional lining cells, which otherwise have a littoral (endothelial-histiocytic) phenotype, supports littoral cell angioma.

ddx.vs: Native sinus littoral cells are CD8-positive throughout, whereas the lining cells of littoral cell angioma are characteristically CD8-negative.
Hemangioma channels are lined by flat endothelial cells lacking histiocytic markers (CD68, CD163) and CD21, while littoral cell angioma coexpresses endothelial and histiocytic markers.
SANT forms multiple angiomatoid nodules in a fibrous stroma containing CD34+/CD31+ capillaries, CD8+/CD31+ sinusoids and CD31+ small veins, rather than a single CD8-negative littoral phenotype.
Angiosarcoma shows solid areas, marked atypia, mitoses and infiltrative growth, which are not seen in this lesion.

62912.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸片中有大型母細胞，細胞質豐富呈灰藍色，核偏位並有明顯的核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof），下方一個大細胞的細胞質充滿細小顆粒；大型母細胞、灰藍細胞質與核旁淡染區是 t(8;21) AML 的典型型態。
features: Large blasts with abundant grey-blue basophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei
Distinct pale perinuclear hof in several blasts
Fine chromatin with visible nucleoli and a few clear nuclear/cytoplasmic vacuoles
Large cell with abundant finely granular cytoplasm, reflecting abnormal maturation
Degenerating cell with vacuolated magenta cytoplasm adjacent to a red cell
Scattered small lymphocytes and normochromic red cells
62912.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a population of large blasts with abundant grey-blue basophilic cytoplasm, eccentrically placed nuclei with fine chromatin and nucleoli, and prominent paler perinuclear zones (hofs). A large cell with abundant finely granular cytoplasm and a degenerating vacuolated cell are also present, along with scattered small lymphocytes. Auer rods are not clearly seen in this field. The combination of large blasts with abundant basophilic cytoplasm, perinuclear hofs, and granules is characteristic of acute myeloid leukemia with t(8;21)(q22;q22.1); RUNX1::RUNX1T1, pending cytogenetic or molecular confirmation.

ddx.vs: Promyelocytes have bilobed or folded nuclei with dense azurophilic granules or hypogranular cytoplasm and bundles of Auer rods, and show PML::RARA.
Monoblasts have round to folded nuclei, grey-blue cytoplasm with pseudopods and vacuoles, but are NSE positive and lack perinuclear hofs.
Show eccentric nuclei with hofs but have coarse clock-face chromatin and are CD138 positive, MPO negative.

62848.recognize_zh: 左側 H&E 為高密度骨髓，含一個巨核細胞，漿細胞不易辨認；右側 CD138 顯示棕色膜狀陽性的漿細胞以鬆散小群與單個細胞散布整片，比 62847 那區的緊密叢集更分散，說明骨髓瘤浸潤分布不均（patchy）。
features: Side-by-side H&E and CD138 immunostain from a different area of the trephine
H&E: hypercellular marrow with mixed cells, a megakaryocyte at left, plasma cells not distinctly recognized
CD138: strong membranous staining of plasma cells in loose small clusters and singly dispersed cells
Plasma cells are numerous but interstitial and non-confluent, unlike tight sheets
CD138-negative residual hematopoietic cells between the clusters
62848.describe_en: H&E section from another area of the bone marrow trephine shows hypercellular marrow with mixed hematopoietic elements and a megakaryocyte, in which plasma cells are not easily distinguished. The accompanying CD138 immunostain highlights numerous plasma cells with strong membranous staining arranged in loose small clusters and as single interstitial cells, without confluent sheets. Comparison with other areas demonstrates a variable, patchy distribution of the infiltrate, which is why the CD138 count should be estimated over the whole core. Findings are consistent with interstitial involvement by plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are generally fewer, perivascular or single, and polytypic by kappa/lambda staining.
The distinction is quantitative: clonal plasma cell percentage (10% threshold) and myeloma-defining events, not morphology alone.
Discohesive plasmacytoid carcinoma cells can be CD138 positive but are cytokeratin, GATA3 and ER positive and kappa/lambda negative.

62784.recognize_zh: 皮膚切片真皮內有結節狀淋巴球浸潤（A、B），免疫染色顯示兩種不同分布：一群為邊界清楚的濾泡中心樣聚集（D），另一群染色細胞環繞在淡染的中心周圍（F–H），提示兩種 B 細胞族群並存，符合複合型 SLL 與皮膚濾泡中心淋巴瘤。
features: Nodular and confluent dermal lymphoid infiltrates beneath an uninvolved epidermis at low power (A)
Dense sheets of predominantly small, dark lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm on H&E (B)
Diffuse strong staining of the nodular infiltrate with a B-cell-type marker (C)
Discrete, sharply circumscribed follicle-like aggregates highlighted by one marker at low power (D)
Scattered positive small cells (likely reactive T cells) intermixed with the infiltrate (E)
A second population staining strongly around pale, marker-negative central nodules, creating a rim/mantle-like pattern (F-H)
62784.describe_en: Skin biopsy shows nodular and confluent dermal lymphoid infiltrates sparing the overlying epidermis. At higher power the infiltrate is composed predominantly of small lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm; cytologic detail of centrocytes/centroblasts is limited at this resolution. Immunohistochemistry (markers not labeled in the figure) shows a diffuse B-cell infiltrate, discrete follicle-like aggregates highlighted by one marker, scattered admixed positive small cells, and a separate population staining strongly around marker-negative central nodules, indicating two spatially distinct B-cell populations. Findings are consistent with a composite cutaneous lymphoma, small lymphocytic lymphoma and primary cutaneous follicle center lymphoma, pending correlation with the specific stains (e.g., CD5, CD23, LEF1 versus CD10, BCL6) and clonality studies.

ddx.vs: Shows nodular infiltrates with reactive follicles colonized by CD5-/CD23-/BCL6- marginal zone cells and plasma cells, rather than a CD5+/CD23+/LEF1+ SLL population plus a BCL6+/CD10+ follicle center population.

Contains polyclonal reactive follicles with polarized germinal centers, tingible-body macrophages and a mixed T-cell-rich background, without an aberrant CD5+/CD23+ B-cell population or clonal light-chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Secondary cutaneous involvement by nodal follicular lymphoma
ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical; typically BCL2+ with t(14;18) and requires staging to exclude systemic disease, whereas primary cutaneous follicle center lymphoma is usually BCL2-negative or weak.
Also CD5+ small B cells, but cyclin D1/SOX11 positive and CD23 negative, unlike SLL.

62784.stain: H&E and IHC panel (markers not labeled)

62720.recognize_zh: 母細胞 gate 的核內 TdT 對細胞質 CD3（cCD3）流式圖：主要族群 TdT 呈連續性弱到中度表現、cCD3 陰性，只有一小群 cCD3 約 10^4 的細胞，比例太少不足以判定 T 系列。
features: Dot plot gated on blasts: nuclear TdT-FITC (x) versus cytoplasmic CD3-PB (y), two overlaid populations (red and green)
Main population shows diagonal smear with TdT ~10^3 to 10^4 and low cCD3 signal (autofluorescence-related diagonal)
Main blast population cytoplasmic CD3 negative
Small separate cluster with cCD3 ~10^4, likely contaminating/residual T cells rather than blasts
Diagonal co-shift pattern suggests nonspecific background; interpret against internal negative controls
62720.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of the blast gate displays nuclear TdT versus cytoplasmic CD3. The major blast population shows variable TdT expression and lacks cytoplasmic CD3, with only a small discrete cCD3-positive cluster that most likely represents admixed T cells. The absence of cytoplasmic CD3 on the blasts excludes T-lineage assignment. Findings support an immature TdT-positive, cCD3-negative blast population, consistent with the reported B/myeloid rather than T/myeloid mixed phenotype acute leukemia.

ddx.vs: T/myeloid MPAL requires cytoplasmic CD3 on the blasts at mature T-cell intensity, which is absent from the main population here.
T-ALL blasts are cCD3 positive and usually TdT positive with CD7, whereas these blasts are cCD3 negative.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with TdT expression
ddx.vs: TdT may be expressed in AML, so B-lineage markers (strong CD19 with CD79a/CD22/CD10) are needed to establish the B component of MPAL.

62656.recognize_zh: 中央聚集的細胞核深染、互相融合，其間夾有均質紫色物質與顆粒碎片，可能代表 LE 現象中核物質與吞噬細胞的聚集；但細胞保存不佳、沒有清楚的單一 LE 細胞，需依臨床（紅斑性狼瘡）判讀。
features: Cluster of crowded, overlapping cells with dark, smudged nuclei
Homogeneous purple material and granular debris between the clustered cells
Some cells with rounded pale-purple nuclear masses lacking chromatin detail
Isolated degenerated cell with clumped nucleus at lower left
Poor cell preservation and thin background with precipitate limit interpretation
62656.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of crowded, overlapping cells with dark, partly smudged nuclei, admixed with homogeneous purple material and granular debris. A few rounded pale nuclear masses without chromatin texture are present within the cluster, and an isolated degenerated cell is seen at the lower left. Cell preservation is poor and no discrete LE cell with a crescentic displaced nucleus can be confidently identified in this field. The findings may represent aggregation of phagocytes around denatured nuclear material in the clinical setting of systemic lupus erythematosus, but they are not diagnostic on their own.

ddx.vs: Crush artifact produces smeared chromatin streaks without phagocytosed homogeneous nuclear bodies inside intact cells.
A tart cell contains an ingested nucleus that retains chromatin structure, unlike the homogeneous LE body.
Precursor clumps have well-preserved individual nuclei with visible chromatin and granulated cytoplasm.

62592.recognize_zh: LMO2 免疫染色（高倍）：部分腫瘤細胞呈強弱不一的核陽性，許多細胞為陰性或弱陽性，而右側血管內皮細胞呈強核陽性可作為內部陽性對照；LMO2 是生發中心標記，帶有 t(14;18) 的濾泡性淋巴瘤常失去 LMO2 表現。
features: Heterogeneous nuclear LMO2 staining in a subset of neoplastic follicular cells
Many tumor nuclei weakly positive or negative
Strong nuclear LMO2 in endothelial cells along the right edge (internal positive control)
Monotonous medium to large cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei
62592.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for LMO2 at high power shows heterogeneous nuclear staining, with a subset of neoplastic follicular cells moderately to strongly positive and many others weakly positive or negative. Endothelial cells along the right side show strong nuclear staining and serve as an internal positive control. LMO2 is a germinal-center marker that is expressed in reactive germinal centers and in most follicular lymphomas lacking BCL2 rearrangement, whereas t(14;18)-positive follicular lymphomas frequently show loss of LMO2. The partial expression here should be interpreted together with BCL2 immunostaining and FISH in this grade 3a follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers show uniform strong LMO2 nuclear staining with BCL2-negative germinal-center cells.
Burkitt lymphoma is characteristically LMO2 negative (MYC-related loss) with a Ki67 near 100% and diffuse starry-sky pattern.
Marginal zone lymphoma cells are LMO2 negative, with positivity limited to residual colonized germinal centers.

62528.recognize_zh: CD20 染色中，棕色陽性的小 B 淋巴球集中在上方與兩側的淋巴組織區，中央擴張竇內的大型組織球為陰性，僅有少量顆粒狀背景染色；顯示竇內的大細胞不是 B 細胞，符合 Rosai-Dorfman 病。
features: Clusters of small CD20-positive B lymphocytes in lymphoid areas at the upper and lateral edges
Central expanded sinus with CD20-negative large histiocytes
Fine granular background staining (likely debris or phagocytosed antigen) within the sinus
No large atypical CD20-positive cells
62528.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD20 highlights small B lymphocytes clustered within the lymphoid compartments bordering an expanded sinus. The large sinus histiocytes are negative, with only faint granular background staining. No sheets of large CD20-positive cells are identified. Findings exclude a large B-cell lymphoma as the cause of the sinus expansion and support a histiocytic process, consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease.

ddx.vs: DLBCL forms sheets of large atypical CD20-positive cells rather than CD20-negative histiocytes.
Monocytoid B cells expanding sinuses are CD20-positive with pale cytoplasm, unlike the CD20-negative histiocytes here.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30/CD15-positive with weak or absent CD20 and are not S100-positive histiocytes.

62464.recognize_zh: 視野中多顆紅血球在中央有一團深染血紅素，外圍一圈淡染環，最外緣又是深染邊，呈牛眼（bull's-eye）狀，就是標靶細胞（target cells）；另有少數細胞表面出現摺痕。
features: Numerous erythrocytes with a central dense hemoglobin spot, a surrounding pale ring, and a peripheral hemoglobinized rim (bull's-eye / target cells)
Target cells are roughly normocytic to slightly large
Several red cells with linear folds or creases and a few small, dense cells without central pallor
Occasional red cells lacking central pallor; scattered platelets
Thin monolayer area of the smear, arguing against a thick-area artifact
62464.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous target cells (codocytes) with a central condensation of hemoglobin, a surrounding pale annulus, and a hemoglobinized peripheral rim. Additional poikilocytes include folded red cells and occasional small dense cells lacking central pallor. Platelets are present and no nucleated red cells or inclusions are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with target cells, which should prompt evaluation for thalassemia, hemoglobin C or E, liver disease, or post-splenectomy state.

ddx.vs: Stomatocytes have a slit-like or mouth-shaped central pallor without a central dense hemoglobin spot.
Artifactual targets are confined to thick or slowly dried areas and often coexist with refractile artifacts, whereas true targets appear throughout the monolayer.

ddx.dx: Hemoglobin C crystals and SC poikilocytes
ddx.vs: HbC disease shows target cells plus rod or 'Washington monument' crystals and folded cells, which requires hemoglobin electrophoresis for confirmation.
Knizocytes show a central bar or ridge of hemoglobin rather than a round central spot.

62400.recognize_zh: 中倍下淋巴結內一片淡粉紅、細胞稀疏的區域，裡面散佈大量深染的點狀核碎屑與淡染組織球，與周圍較深藍紫色的淋巴組織交界不規則；這種以凋亡碎屑為主、無膿瘍的斑片狀壞死要想到菊池病（Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease）。
features: Patchy pale eosinophilic area of necrosis within lymph node parenchyma
Abundant dot-like karyorrhectic/apoptotic debris throughout the lesion
Numerous pale histiocytes intermixed with debris
No neutrophilic abscess formation or granulomas at this magnification
Irregular transition to surrounding cellular lymphoid tissue
62400.describe_en: Sections of lymph node show a patchy, pale eosinophilic area of necrosis containing abundant karyorrhectic apoptotic debris intermixed with numerous histiocytes. The lesion merges irregularly with the surrounding cellular lymphoid tissue. At this magnification there are no neutrophilic abscesses or well-formed granulomas. The findings are suggestive of histiocytic necrotizing lymphadenitis (Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease); higher-power evaluation and exclusion of lupus and infection are recommended.

ddx.vs: Lupus shows similar necrosis but may contain hematoxylin bodies and more plasma cells, and requires serologic correlation.
Granulomatous infections show caseous necrosis rimmed by epithelioid histiocytes and giant cells rather than karyorrhectic debris without granulomas.
Lymphoma shows sheets of atypical cells at the viable edge, confirmed by clonal immunophenotype.

62336.recognize_zh: 腰椎矢狀面 T1 脂肪抑制打顯影劑影像：椎體骨髓訊號不均勻，夾雜多個斑片狀強化區與低訊號病灶，上方胸腰交界的後方結構與椎管後側有明顯強化，符合骨髓瘤活動性病灶並可能延伸至硬膜外。
features: Sagittal fat-suppressed post-contrast T1-weighted MRI of the lower thoracic and lumbar spine
Diffusely heterogeneous marrow signal with patchy enhancing foci in multiple vertebral bodies
Several rounded non-enhancing hypointense foci within vertebral bodies
Avid enhancement of posterior elements at the upper (thoracolumbar) level extending toward the posterior spinal canal
Intervertebral discs not enhancing; sacrum also shows heterogeneous signal
62336.describe_en: Sagittal fat-suppressed post-contrast T1-weighted MRI of the lumbar spine shows diffusely heterogeneous marrow signal with patchy enhancing foci and scattered rounded hypointense lesions in multiple vertebral bodies and the sacrum. At the upper (thoracolumbar) level there is avid enhancement of the posterior elements extending toward the dorsal spinal canal, raising concern for epidural extension. The intervertebral discs are not involved. The pattern of multifocal enhancing marrow lesions superimposed on diffuse marrow abnormality is consistent with active myelomatous involvement.

ddx.vs: Metastases give a similar multifocal enhancing pattern, so M-protein studies and bone marrow or lesion biopsy are needed to distinguish them.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma of bone with epidural extension
ddx.vs: Lymphoma can also cause marrow infiltration with epidural soft tissue, and tissue diagnosis (CD20/PAX5 versus CD138/light chains) is required.
Infection shows disc and endplate involvement with rim-enhancing fluid collections, whereas discs are spared here.

62208.recognize_zh: 這是一張流式細胞儀的百分比表格（panel B）：CD19 94%、CD20 93%、CD22 95%、CD5 77%、CD23 67%，而 FMC7 僅 4%、CD10 <1%，呈現 CD5+/CD23+/FMC7− 的 B 細胞表型，符合 CLL。
features: Tabulated flow cytometry results (percent positive) for lymphoid, myeloid and other markers
B-cell markers high: CD19 94%, CD20 93%, CD22 95%, HLA-DR 95%, CD45 95%
Aberrant CD5 co-expression 77% with CD23 67%
No T-cell, myeloid or immaturity markers (CD34, TdT) reported as positive
62208.describe_en: This figure is a tabulated flow cytometry report rather than a morphologic image. The gated population is predominantly B cells (CD19 94%, CD20 93%, CD22 95%, HLA-DR 95%) with co-expression of CD5 (77%) and CD23 (67%), while FMC7 (4%), CD10 (<1%) and CD25 (2%) are essentially negative and CD11c is partially expressed (23%). Immaturity markers are not reported as positive. This CD5+/CD23+/FMC7-negative/CD10-negative B-cell phenotype is consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia; light-chain restriction and antigen intensity (dim CD20, dim surface immunoglobulin) are not shown in this table and would strengthen the interpretation.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma is CD5-positive but usually CD23-negative and FMC7-positive with bright CD20, and requires cyclin D1/SOX11 or t(11;14) confirmation.
B-PLL is typically CD5-weak/negative, CD23-negative and FMC7-bright, in contrast to the CD5+/CD23+/FMC7-negative profile shown.
Hairy cell leukemia is CD11c/CD25/CD103-bright and CD5/CD23-negative, whereas here CD25 is 2% and CD5/CD23 are positive.

62080.recognize_zh: 這是 HBB 基因的 Sanger 定序圖（非形態圖）：前段單一清楚峰值，約在 AGG（codon 40）之後開始出現重疊的雙峰，代表此處起有異型合子的插入或缺失造成讀框位移，常見如 codon 41/42（-TTCT）。
features: Sanger sequencing electropherogram of HBB (non-morphologic)
Clean single peaks through ...CCTTGGACCCAGAGG (approximately codons 36-40)
Abrupt onset of overlapping double peaks immediately downstream, persisting along the read
Pattern indicates a heterozygous small insertion/deletion causing frameshift, plausibly codons 41/42 (-TTCT)
Base calls after the transition are unreliable because two sequences are superimposed
62080.describe_en: This is a Sanger sequencing electropherogram of the beta-globin (HBB) gene rather than a morphologic image. The trace shows clean single peaks through the sequence corresponding to approximately codons 36-40, followed by an abrupt transition to overlapping double peaks that persist downstream. This pattern indicates a heterozygous small insertion or deletion producing a frameshift, with the location consistent with the common codons 41/42 (-TTCT) beta-zero mutation, although exact nomenclature requires reverse-strand sequencing or deconvolution. A beta-thalassemia major phenotype would additionally require a second pathogenic HBB allele (compound heterozygosity) on the other chromosome.

ddx.dx: Heterozygous point mutation (e.g., IVS-II-654 C>T, codon 17 A>T)
ddx.vs: A single-nucleotide variant produces one isolated double peak with clean sequence on either side, not a persistent run of superimposed peaks.

ddx.dx: Sequencing artifact from poor template or dye blobs
ddx.vs: Artifacts give noisy low peaks or broad blobs throughout, whereas a true indel shows a sharp, reproducible transition point confirmed on the reverse strand.
A homozygous indel yields clean single peaks of the altered sequence rather than overlapping double peaks.

62016.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中一顆小型顆粒球，核未分葉、呈圓形且染色質粗塊狀，細胞質淡灰帶細小顆粒；「成熟染色質卻不分葉」的圓核中性球即類 Pelger 樣變化（pseudo-Pelger-Huët），是 MDS 顆粒球發育不良的線索。
features: Small granulocyte with a round, non-lobated nucleus and coarsely clumped mature chromatin
Pale grey-blue cytoplasm with sparse fine granules (hypogranular)
Mild red cell anisocytosis with occasional ovalocytes and teardrop-like forms
Scattered small platelets
No blasts in this field
62016.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a granulocyte with a round, non-segmented nucleus containing coarsely clumped mature chromatin and pale, hypogranular cytoplasm, consistent with a pseudo-Pelger-Huet (non-lobated) neutrophil. The red cells show mild anisocytosis with occasional ovalocytes. Scattered platelets are present, and no blasts are seen. The findings are consistent with dysgranulopoiesis, supporting a myelodysplastic neoplasm such as MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes have a thin rim of clear blue agranular cytoplasm, whereas this cell has broader grey granular neutrophilic cytoplasm and blocky segmented-type chromatin.
Immature granulocytes have finer chromatin and more abundant specific granules rather than condensed chromatin with hypogranular cytoplasm.
The inherited anomaly involves nearly all neutrophils with normal granulation and no cytopenias.

61952.recognize_zh: 高倍EBER原位雜交可見大小不一的細胞核呈深藍色陽性，包括中小型淋巴球與較大的免疫母細胞，陽性細胞零散分布於紅色對比染色背景中，是EBV再活化的典型表現。
features: Dark blue nuclear EBER signal in scattered cells (chromogenic ISH, red counterstain)
Positive cells include small-to-intermediate lymphocytes and larger immunoblast-sized nuclei
Variable signal intensity from faint to strong
Positive cells dispersed, not forming sheets; a vascular space crosses the field
61952.describe_en: High-power EBER in situ hybridization shows scattered nuclei with blue EBER signal of variable intensity in a red-counterstained background. The positive cells span a range of sizes, from small lymphocytes to larger immunoblasts, and are dispersed individually adjacent to a vascular space. The presence of numerous EBER-positive cells across a spectrum of sizes supports an EBV-driven reactive lymphoid proliferation (EBV reactivation).

ddx.vs: EBER positivity in cHL is essentially confined to large HRS cells, whereas here many small cells are also positive.
ENKTL shows EBER in nearly all atypical cells with angiocentric destruction and necrosis, rather than a subset of scattered cells.

ddx.dx: Chronic active EBV disease / EBV+ T/NK LPD
ddx.vs: These require clinical persistence and demonstration of EBV in T or NK cells by double staining, which cannot be determined from EBER alone.

61888.recognize_zh: 單一視野內擠滿各成熟階段的顆粒球：髓細胞、腎形核的後髓細胞、帶狀核與分葉核（標2–5、7、8），中央還有一個充滿深紫黑色粗顆粒的嗜鹼性球（標6），這種「髓細胞＋嗜鹼性球增多」的組合是CML周邊血液的典型表現。
features: Marked granulocytic leukocytosis with the full spectrum of maturation in one field: myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Metamyelocytes and bands (labeled 2, 3) with kidney- or horseshoe-shaped nuclei and clumped chromatin
Myelocytes (labeled 5, 7) with round eccentric nuclei and abundant granular cytoplasm
Basophil (labeled 6) with coarse dark purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus
Maturing granulocytes lack overt dysplasia (normal granulation and nuclear segmentation)
Background red cells with mild poikilocytosis and scattered platelets
61888.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis composed of granulocytes at all stages of maturation, with numerous myelocytes, metamyelocytes and band forms in addition to segmented neutrophils. A basophil is present, and the granulocytes lack significant dysplastic features. Blasts are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, in chronic phase; confirmation by BCR::ABL1 FISH/RT-PCR is required.

ddx.vs: Reactive neutrophilia is dominated by segmented and band neutrophils with toxic changes and lacks the myelocyte bulge and absolute basophilia seen here.
Atypical CML shows dysgranulopoiesis and minimal basophilia, whereas the granulocytes here are morphologically normal with a basophil present.
CNL shows mature segmented neutrophils with fewer than 10% immature granulocytes and a CSF3R mutation, not a myelocyte-rich left shift.
PMF gives a leukoerythroblastic smear with teardrop cells and nucleated red cells, usually without this degree of granulocytic leukocytosis, and lacks BCR::ABL1.

61824.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片上方有一顆巨核細胞，細胞質內含四到五個彼此分離的圓形核，背景為高細胞性、紅血球與顆粒球系前驅細胞混雜並散在含鐵血黃素，提示巨核細胞發育不良。
features: Megakaryocyte with four to five widely separated round nuclei in abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Hypercellular marrow between adipocytes
Numerous erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei, some in clusters
Maturing granulocytes including band and segmented neutrophils
Scattered brown hemosiderin deposits
61824.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow core biopsy shows hypercellular marrow between adipocytes with trilineage hematopoiesis, including clusters of erythroid precursors and maturing granulocytes. A megakaryocyte with four to five widely separated round nuclei is present, representing a dysplastic multinucleated form. Hemosiderin deposits are scattered, and no blast aggregates are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia in a myelodysplastic neoplasm associated with germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts lie along bone trabeculae with many uniform nuclei and a nucleolus in each, rather than within the intertrabecular marrow.
Reactive megakaryocytes have connected lobulated nuclei rather than discrete separated nuclei.
MPN megakaryocytes are clustered, enlarged and hyperlobated or hyperchromatic rather than multinucleated with separate round nuclei.

61632.recognize_zh: 高倍下大型細胞沿著斜走的竇狀血管內成排排列，核卵圓至凹陷、染色質泡狀、一至數個明顯核仁、細胞質淡染，周圍是較小的造血細胞；腫瘤細胞侷限於血管腔內是診斷血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的重點。
features: Large atypical cells aligned within a diagonally oriented sinusoid
Oval to indented/cleaved nuclei with vesicular chromatin and one to several prominent nucleoli
Moderate pale to amphophilic cytoplasm with distinct cell membranes
Surrounding smaller hematopoietic cells (erythroid precursors, granulocytes) outside the vascular lumen
No sheet-like or mass-forming extravascular infiltrate
61632.describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows large atypical lymphoid cells confined within a sinusoidal lumen, arranged in a linear cluster. The cells have oval to indented nuclei with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm, and are two to three times the size of the surrounding hematopoietic cells. Adjacent marrow shows residual erythroid and myeloid elements without an extravascular mass. The intrasinusoidal distribution of large atypical cells is consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma, to be confirmed by CD20 and CD31/CD34 immunostains.

ddx.vs: Conventional DLBCL forms interstitial or nodular extravascular aggregates rather than being confined to sinusoidal lumina.
Sinusoidal but composed of monotonous medium-sized cells with less prominent nucleoli and a CD3+ CD4- CD8- T-cell phenotype.
Megakaryocytes have multilobated nuclei with abundant pink cytoplasm and are extravascular, while proerythroblasts form interstitial islands rather than intraluminal strings.
Carcinoma emboli are cohesive and keratin positive, not CD20 positive.

61568.recognize_zh: 閘選母細胞的 CRLF2 PE 直方圖整體右移，76.72% 母細胞為 CRLF2 陽性（弱至中度），相較於紫色參考族群明顯偏高；CRLF2 過度表現是 BCR::ABL1-like（Ph-like）B-ALL 最常見的篩檢線索。
features: Single-parameter histogram of CRLF2-PE (x-axis, log) versus count on the gated blast population
Unimodal red blast peak centered around 5 × 10^0 on the log scale
Positivity marker (H+) set at about 3 × 10^0, with 76.72% of blasts CRLF2-positive
Small purple overlay peak at lower intensity (reference/negative population)
Expression is dim-to-moderate rather than bright, with no bimodal separation
61568.describe_en: This flow cytometry histogram displays CRLF2 (PE) expression on the gated blast population. The blasts form a unimodal peak shifted to the right of the lower-intensity purple reference population, with 76.72% of blasts falling in the CRLF2-positive region. Expression is dim-to-moderate and continuous rather than bimodal, so the result depends on correct placement of the positivity cutoff against an appropriate negative control. CRLF2 overexpression in B-lymphoblastic leukemia is a surrogate for CRLF2 rearrangement (P2RY8::CRLF2 or IGH::CRLF2) and supports the BCR::ABL1-like subtype, which should be confirmed by FISH or molecular testing.

ddx.dx: Other BCR::ABL1-like B-ALL (ABL-class or JAK2 fusions)
ddx.vs: May be CRLF2-negative by flow, so a negative histogram does not exclude Ph-like ALL and requires RNA-based fusion testing.
CRLF2 rearrangement is frequent in DS-ALL, so overexpression is not specific to non-syndromic Ph-like ALL; clinical context is needed.

ddx.dx: Nonspecific dim staining / inadequate negative control
ddx.vs: A shift of the whole population near the cutoff can reflect autofluorescence or isotype issues and should be compared with internal normal lymphocytes.

61504.recognize_zh: 紅血球之間可見多個碎片狀紅血球（schistocyte），邊緣呈尖角、三角形或頭盔狀（helmet cell），另有兩顆較大、偏灰藍色的多染性紅血球（polychromasia）；在移植後使用 tacrolimus 的病人，應考慮移植相關血栓性微血管病變。
features: Several schistocytes: small triangular and helmet-shaped red cell fragments with sharp angular edges
Mild anisocytosis with scattered microspherocyte-like fragments
Two large bluish-gray polychromatophilic red cells indicating reticulocytosis
Platelets present as small single forms; no platelet clumps
No nucleated red cells, agglutination, or intracellular parasites in this field
61504.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis and several schistocytes, including triangular fragments and helmet cells with sharp angular edges. Occasional polychromatophilic red cells are present, indicating a marrow response. Platelets are seen as single forms without clumping, and no red cell agglutination or parasites are identified. In a patient receiving tacrolimus after hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, findings are consistent with a microangiopathic hemolytic process such as transplant-associated thrombotic microangiopathy.

ddx.vs: TTP shows the same schistocytes, so separation depends on ADAMTS13 activity below 10% rather than morphology.
DIC also produces schistocytes but is accompanied by prolonged PT/aPTT, low fibrinogen, and high D-dimer.
Valve-related fragmentation occurs with a prosthetic valve history and normal platelet counts.

ddx.dx: Bite or blister cells of oxidative hemolysis
ddx.vs: Bite cells retain an intact rounded contour with a semicircular notch, whereas schistocytes are small angular fragments with pointed ends.

61440.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中央有一顆大型前紅血球母細胞，核內染色質被均質淡染、玻璃樣的病毒包涵體取代，核膜周邊染色質濃縮成一圈（lantern cell）；周圍可見含棕色含鐵血黃素的巨噬細胞，提示微小病毒 B19 感染。
features: Central enlarged pronormoblast with a large nucleus showing a pale, glassy eosinophilic-to-amphophilic intranuclear inclusion
Chromatin marginated to the nuclear membrane, giving a rim-like appearance and a small eccentric chromatin clump
Scattered macrophages with golden-brown hemosiderin pigment
Hematopoietic cells of mixed lineage, with relatively few maturing erythroid precursors in this field
Adipocytes and a stromal/vascular structure crossing the field
