2240.recognize_zh: 心包液抹片中幾乎滿視野都是分葉核的嗜中性球，僅夾雜少數較大、核圓的巨噬細胞或間皮細胞，背景有少量紅血球，屬急性化膿性（neutrophil-predominant）滲出液。
features: Markedly cellular fluid composed predominantly of segmented neutrophils
Neutrophils with 2–4 nuclear lobes and pale pink cytoplasm; some degenerative changes
Scattered larger mononuclear cells (macrophages/mesothelial cells) with round nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm
Background of scattered red blood cells and proteinaceous material
No malignant cell clusters or organisms identifiable at this magnification
2240.describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation of pericardial fluid shows a markedly cellular specimen composed predominantly of segmented neutrophils. Scattered macrophages and occasional mesothelial-type cells are present in a background of red blood cells and proteinaceous debris. No atypical cell clusters are seen, and organisms cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a neutrophil-predominant (acute inflammatory/purulent) pericardial effusion; correlation with Gram stain and culture is recommended.

ddx.vs: Tuberculous and viral effusions are dominated by small mature lymphocytes rather than sheets of segmented neutrophils.
Malignant effusions contain cohesive three-dimensional clusters of atypical cells with nuclear pleomorphism, which are absent here.
Blood contamination yields a white cell differential mirroring blood with abundant RBCs, not a dense near-pure neutrophil population.

2176.recognize_zh: 小腸黏膜低中倍：絨毛短鈍、形狀扭曲，固有層被密集淋巴樣細胞塞滿並侵入腺體上皮，部分黏膜碎裂脫落；此黏膜內密集浸潤搭配絨毛破壞，符合腸病相關 T 細胞淋巴瘤的切片型態。
features: Blunted, irregular villi with distorted crypts
Dense cellular infiltrate expanding the lamina propria
Infiltrating cells permeate glandular and surface epithelium
Congested vessels within the mucosa
Fragmented, partly detached mucosal strips; high-power cytology not assessable
2176.describe_en: Section of small-intestinal mucosa at low-to-medium power shows blunted, irregular villi and distorted crypts, with the lamina propria expanded by a dense lymphoid infiltrate that permeates the surface and glandular epithelium. Mucosal vessels are congested, and portions of the mucosa are fragmented. Cellular detail is limited at this magnification. In correlation with cytologic atypia and T-cell immunophenotype, findings are consistent with enteropathy-associated T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Celiac disease has villous atrophy with crypt hyperplasia and bland intraepithelial lymphocytes but no expansile atypical T-cell infiltrate.
Inflammatory enteritis shows a mixed infiltrate with neutrophils, cryptitis and granulomas rather than a monotonous lymphoid population.

ddx.dx: MALT lymphoma of the small bowel
ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma forms lymphoepithelial lesions with CD20+ centrocyte-like B cells, whereas EATL cells are CD3+ T cells.

1664.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的骨髓小粒（particle）經普魯士藍（Prussian blue）染色，小粒內可見散在藍色含鐵血黃素沉積，代表儲存鐵存在；但影像失焦、厚度大，無法評估環狀鐵芽球。
features: Thick marrow particle stained with Prussian blue
Blue granular and amorphous hemosiderin deposits within the particle stroma/macrophages
Deposits distributed across much of the particle, indicating presence of storage iron
Orange-brown counterstained cellular background
Out-of-focus, thick area precludes assessment of sideroblasts
1664.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate particle stained with Prussian blue shows blue hemosiderin deposits distributed within the particle, indicating that storage iron is present, likely within macrophages. The image is thick and out of focus, so a formal semiquantitative grade (0 to 6+) is only approximate and individual erythroid precursors cannot be evaluated for sideroblasts or ring sideroblasts. Findings indicate adequate marrow storage iron, which argues against iron deficiency; assessment of sideroblasts requires a thin, well-focused area at high power.

ddx.vs: Particles show absent blue staining in stromal macrophages, whereas storage iron is clearly present here.
Shows normal or increased macrophage iron but reduced or absent sideroblasts, which cannot be evaluated in this thick field.

ddx.dx: Sideroblastic anemia / MDS with ring sideroblasts
ddx.vs: Requires identification of erythroblasts with at least five perinuclear iron granules encircling a third of the nucleus in a thin area, not particle iron.

60928.recognize_zh: 兩顆大細胞並排，左側核上緣有淺凹陷（心形），染色質細緻均勻，灰藍色細胞質帶細顆粒與小空泡，右側細胞類似且有空泡，符合前單核球（promonocytes）。
features: Two large adjacent mononuclear cells, each more than twice the red cell diameter
Left cell nucleus with a shallow notch giving a heart-shaped outline; right cell nucleus round to oval
Finely granular, evenly dispersed chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli
Moderate grey-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and small clustered vacuoles, particularly in the upper cytoplasm
Background normochromic red cells, some with small central pallor
60928.describe_en: High-power smear shows two large mononuclear cells with moderate grey-blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules and small vacuoles. The left cell has a gently notched, heart-shaped nucleus, and the right cell a round to oval nucleus; both show finely dispersed chromatin without prominent nucleoli. The chromatin is less condensed than in mature monocytes, and no Auer rods are identified. Findings are consistent with promonocytes, which are counted as blast equivalents in the assessment of acute monocytic or myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts are round with more basophilic cytoplasm and one or more prominent nucleoli, lacking the nuclear folding seen here.
Mature monocytes show condensed, clumped chromatin and more deeply folded, lobulated nuclei.
Promyelocytes have a paranuclear hof and abundant coarse azurophilic granules; nonspecific esterase negativity versus positivity separates them if uncertain.

60032.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆比周圍造血細胞大上好幾倍的巨大細胞，細胞核多葉且重疊成一團，周圍是大量淡紫粉色、細顆粒的細胞質，這是成熟巨核細胞（megakaryocyte）。
features: Very large cell, many times the diameter of surrounding myeloid and erythroid precursors
Single multilobated nucleus with overlapping, clustered lobes (not separate nuclei)
Coarse but not pyknotic chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
Abundant pale lilac-pink, finely granular cytoplasm consistent with a mature (granular) megakaryocyte
Background cellular aspirate particle edge with maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors, and lymphocytes
60032.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle edge with a mixed population of maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. Centrally there is a very large megakaryocyte with a single, complexly lobulated nucleus whose lobes are overlapping and connected, and abundant pale, finely granular cytoplasm. No hypolobation, separated nuclear lobes, or small (micromegakaryocytic) forms are seen in this cell. Findings are consistent with a normal mature megakaryocyte.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts contain multiple separate, uniform round nuclei with nucleoli in a coarsely granular cytoplasm, rather than one lobulated nucleus.
Dysplastic forms show hypolobated/monolobated nuclei, widely separated nuclear lobes, or micromegakaryocytes, which are absent here.

ddx.dx: Metastatic tumor cell or tumor giant cell
ddx.vs: Tumor cells usually form cohesive clusters with high N:C ratio, prominent nucleoli, and lack the finely granular platelet-producing cytoplasm.
MPN megakaryocytes are often hyperlobated/staghorn (ET) or bulbous and clustered (PMF), best assessed on the biopsy rather than a single aspirate cell.

128.recognize_zh: 結腸黏膜固有層被小型、成熟外觀的淋巴球瀰漫性擴張，把腺窩撐開但腺窩結構大致保留、無明顯破壞或上皮浸潤；免疫染色為 CD3+、CD8+、CD4−、CD5 喪失、TIA-1+、Granzyme B−，MIB-1 極低，PCR 顯示 TCR 單株重排，符合胃腸道惰性 T 細胞淋巴增生性疾病（indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract）。
features: Dense, monotonous infiltrate of small lymphocytes expanding the lamina propria and separating crypts, with largely preserved crypt architecture
Small cells with slightly irregular, dense nuclei, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm; no significant cytologic atypia or large cells
No destructive lymphoepithelial lesions or prominent epitheliotropism; scattered eosinophils and plasma cells in the background
IHC: CD3+, CD2+, CD7+, CD5 largely lost, CD8+, CD4-, TCR-beta F1+, TIA-1+, granzyme B-, CD56-, CD20 only scattered B cells
MIB-1 (Ki-67) very low in the lymphoid infiltrate (positive mainly in crypt epithelium)
PCR: clonal TCR beta and TCR gamma rearrangements with polyclonal IGH; endoscopy shows multiple small mucosal polyps
128.describe_en: Endoscopic colonic biopsies show fragments of mucosa in which the lamina propria is diffusely expanded by a dense, monotonous infiltrate of small lymphocytes that separates but does not destroy the crypts. The lymphocytes have small, slightly irregular dense nuclei, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm, admixed with occasional eosinophils and plasma cells; there is no significant epitheliotropism, necrosis or large-cell component. Immunohistochemistry shows the infiltrate to be CD3+, CD2+, CD7+, CD8+, TCR-beta F1+ and TIA-1+ with loss of CD5 and negativity for CD4, CD56 and granzyme B, with only scattered CD20+ B cells and a very low MIB-1 proliferation index. PCR studies demonstrate clonal TCR beta and gamma gene rearrangements with a polyclonal IGH pattern. In the setting of multiple small polyps and a protracted course without progression, findings are consistent with indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract (indolent T-cell lymphoma of the GI tract, WHO 5th edition).

ddx.vs: MEITL shows marked epitheliotropism by medium-sized monomorphic cells that are typically CD8+, CD56+, often MATK+ with a high Ki-67, unlike the non-epitheliotropic CD56-negative, low-proliferation infiltrate here.
EATL presents with ulcerating, destructive masses of medium-to-large pleomorphic cells with necrosis, frequent CD30 expression and a high proliferation index in the setting of celiac disease.

Reactive colitis has a mixed CD4/CD8 infiltrate with plasma cell-rich lamina propria, crypt distortion or cryptitis, preserved CD5 and polyclonal TCR, whereas this infiltrate is monotonous CD8+, CD5-lost and clonal.
NK/T-cell lymphoma is angiocentric and necrotic with CD56+, cytotoxic granule (granzyme B) positive cells and EBER positivity, which are absent here.

128.stain: H&E, IHC panel, PCR TCR/IGH clonality, endoscopy
captions: Early biopsy IHC panel: CD3, CD2 and CD7 positive, CD5 largely lost, CD20 only scattered B cells
Colonoscopy: multiple small sessile mucosal polyps
H&E low power: fragmented colonic biopsies with lamina propria expanded by lymphoid infiltrate
H&E, four fields: dense sheets of small lymphocytes in lamina propria
Early biopsy IHC: CD4 negative, CD8 positive in the lymphoid infiltrate
PCR gels: clonal TCR beta and TCR gamma rearrangements (boxed bands), IGH polyclonal/negative
H&E low power: colonic mucosa with crypts separated by a dense lamina propria infiltrate
H&E low power: preserved crypt architecture with diffuse lamina propria expansion
H&E medium power: intact crypts surrounded by dense small lymphocytes without destruction
H&E high power: small lymphocytes with irregular dense nuclei, scattered eosinophils
H&E high power: monotonous small lymphocytes between crypts with admixed eosinophils and plasma cells
Colon IHC: CD3 and CD2 positive, CD5 negative, CD20 rare
Colon IHC: CD4 scattered, CD8 diffusely positive
Colon IHC: CD56 and granzyme B negative, TIA-1 and TCR-beta F1 positive
CD8 high power: strong membranous staining of the lamina propria lymphocytes
MIB-1: very low proliferation in lymphoid cells, positive in crypt epithelium

64.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中出現纖維化區，內含嗜酸性球、淋巴球、組織球的混合背景，其間散在帶大核仁的大型雙核／多葉核細胞（Reed-Sternberg cell）；這些大細胞 CD30 膜狀加高基氏體（Golgi）點狀陽性、CD15 顆粒狀陽性、B 細胞標記陰性，EBER 陽性，符合 EBV 陽性古典型何杰金淋巴瘤侵犯骨髓。
features: Patchy fibrotic areas replacing marrow adjacent to residual trilineage hematopoiesis and fat
Polymorphous background of small lymphocytes, eosinophils, histiocytes, and plasma cells within fibrosis
Scattered large binucleate/multilobated Reed-Sternberg and mononuclear Hodgkin cells with inclusion-like macronucleoli
Large cells show strong membranous and Golgi-pattern CD30 and granular/Golgi CD15 staining
Large cells negative for the B-cell/leukocyte marker that stains background small lymphocytes
EBER in situ hybridization shows nuclear signal in scattered large cells; PET image shows bulky mediastinal and multifocal osseous uptake
64.describe_en: The whole-body PET maximum intensity projection shows bulky FDG-avid mediastinal disease with multifocal skeletal uptake in the spine, pelvis, and proximal femur, in addition to physiologic renal and bladder activity. The bone marrow core biopsy shows patchy areas of fibrosis replacing marrow, adjacent to residual hematopoietic marrow. Within the fibrotic foci there is a polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, eosinophils, and histiocytes with scattered large mononuclear and binucleate cells bearing prominent eosinophilic nucleoli, consistent with Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells. By immunohistochemistry, the large cells are positive for CD30 (membranous and Golgi) and CD15 (granular/Golgi) and are negative for the marker highlighting background small lymphocytes; EBER in situ hybridization is positive in the large cells. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by EBV-positive classical Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with Hodgkin-like cells
ddx.vs: PTCL shows atypical small-to-medium T cells with a monoclonal TCR rearrangement and CD15-negative large cells, whereas here the background lymphocytes are bland and the large cells co-express CD30 and CD15.
Its large cells are CD20/OCT2/BOB1 strongly positive and CD15/CD30 negative, whereas the large cells here lack B-cell marker staining and express CD30 and CD15.

ddx.dx: Reactive marrow fibrosis or granulomatous marrow (e.g., infection)
ddx.vs: Reactive processes lack CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells, which are present in this biopsy.

ddx.dx: Primary myelofibrosis or other MPN with fibrosis
ddx.vs: MPN fibrosis shows clustered atypical megakaryocytes and streaming hematopoiesis without a polymorphous eosinophil-rich infiltrate or CD30+ Hodgkin cells.

64.stain: H&E; IHC: CD30, CD15; ISH: EBER; PET
captions: PET MIP: bulky mediastinal uptake with multifocal skeletal lesions
Marrow biopsy, low power: fibrotic foci adjacent to residual hematopoietic marrow
Marrow biopsy, medium power: fibrosis with polymorphous infiltrate and scattered large cells
Marrow biopsy, high power: binucleate Reed-Sternberg-like cell in eosinophil-rich background
IHC: large cells negative; scattered small background lymphocytes positive
IHC: weak granular staining in a large cell; scattered small cells positive
IHC CD30: membranous and Golgi staining of Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells
IHC CD15: granular/Golgi staining of a large cell, background myeloid cells positive
EBER ISH: nuclear signal in scattered large cells

62272.recognize_zh: 低倍 CD10 染色中，上方一個明顯擴大的結節裡，CD10 陽性的生發中心 B 細胞被打散成許多不規則的小團塊，彼此之間夾著大量 CD10 陰性的小淋巴球（外套區細胞侵入）；下方則有一個較小、較完整的生發中心可比較，這就是生發中心漸進性轉化（PTGC）的典型碎裂樣式。
features: Markedly enlarged nodule several times the size of a normal follicle (upper field)
CD10-positive germinal center cells broken up into multiple irregular, fragmented clusters within the nodule
Large numbers of CD10-negative small lymphocytes (mantle zone cells) permeating and separating the germinal center fragments
Smaller, more compact CD10-positive germinal center in the lower field for comparison
Scattered single CD10-positive cells in interfollicular areas; no CD10 staining outside follicular structures in sheets
62272.describe_en: Low-power CD10 immunohistochemistry of a lymph node shows a markedly enlarged nodule in which CD10-positive germinal center B cells are fragmented into multiple irregular clusters that are separated and infiltrated by numerous CD10-negative small lymphocytes, representing mantle zone cell ingrowth. A smaller, more intact CD10-positive germinal center is present nearby for comparison. No CD10-positive cells are seen in interfollicular sheets. The findings are consistent with progressive transformation of germinal centers.

ddx.vs: NLPHL nodules also contain small B cells but harbor scattered large LP cells (CD20+, OCT2/BOB1 strong, EMA+) ringed by PD-1+ T cells, whereas PTGC has no LP cells and retains CD10+ germinal center remnants.
FL shows back-to-back uniform follicles with CD10+ cells that are BCL2-positive and may extend into interfollicular areas, unlike the fragmented BCL2-negative germinal center remnants in PTGC.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: Follicular colonization shows CD10-negative, BCL2-positive marginal zone cells replacing germinal centers with light-chain restriction, whereas PTGC is polytypic.
MCL may surround residual 'naked' germinal centers, but the expanded cells are CD5+, cyclin D1+ and SOX11+.

61760.recognize_zh: 整片中型淋巴樣細胞呈瀰漫片狀排列，幾乎全部呈強陽性的細胞質／膜型 BCL2 染色，只有散在的組織細胞與內皮細胞為陰性（藍色）；配合標題，這是被套細胞淋巴瘤（mantle cell lymphoma）母細胞樣亞型的 BCL2 免疫染色。
features: Diffuse sheet-like proliferation of monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells without follicular architecture
Strong, uniform cytoplasmic and perinuclear/membranous BCL2 staining in nearly all tumor cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei outlined by the brown rim of staining
Scattered BCL2-negative histiocytes and endothelial cells with blue hematoxylin counterstain
No residual BCL2-negative germinal centers identified in this field
61760.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for BCL2 shows a diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells. Virtually all neoplastic cells show strong cytoplasmic/perinuclear BCL2 positivity, with only interspersed histiocytes and endothelial cells negative. BCL2 expression is expected in mantle cell lymphoma and is not discriminatory by itself; the blastoid cytology is not assessable on this stain and cyclin D1/SOX11 are required for classification. Findings are consistent with the provided diagnosis of mantle cell lymphoma, blastoid variant.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma / high-grade B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Both can be BCL2-positive with blastoid cells, but mantle cell lymphoma is cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive with t(11;14)(q13;q32).
Lymphoblasts express TdT and often CD34 and lack surface light chain and cyclin D1.
Follicular lymphoma is CD10/BCL6 positive and cyclin D1 negative, whereas mantle cell lymphoma is CD5 positive and CD10 negative.

ddx.dx: Pleomorphic variant of mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Separated from blastoid variant only on H&E cytology (larger, pleomorphic nuclei with nucleoli), not on BCL2 staining.

1472.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀圖，不是形態圖：FSC/SSC 上圈出高側向散射的 myeloid gate，右圖這群細胞 CD33 陽性、CD34 陰性，代表以成熟中的顆粒球為主，缺乏 CD34+ 芽細胞增加，符合 CML 慢性期的表現。
features: Left plot: forward vs side scatter with a large gated population of intermediate-to-high side scatter (Myeloid Gate)
Right plot: gated events are uniformly CD33-positive (PE)
Gated events are CD34-negative (FITC), with only rare scattered CD34+ events
No discrete CD34+ blast cluster identified
Profile indicates maturing myeloid cells rather than an immature blast population
1472.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis displays a forward/side scatter plot with a large population gated in the myeloid region, showing intermediate to high side scatter typical of granulocytic cells. On CD33 versus CD34, the gated cells are CD33-positive and CD34-negative, without a distinct CD34-positive blast population. These plots indicate a predominance of maturing myeloid cells. The flow findings are non-specific and do not establish CML; confirmation requires detection of BCR::ABL1 by cytogenetics, FISH, or RT-PCR.

ddx.dx: CML in accelerated or blast phase
ddx.vs: Progression is suggested by an expanded CD34+ (often with aberrant antigen) blast population, which is absent in these plots.
Reactive granulocytes give the same CD33+CD34- flow pattern, so separation requires BCR::ABL1 testing and blood smear features such as basophilia.
CNL also shows mature CD34- granulocytes but lacks BCR::ABL1 and typically harbors CSF3R mutation.
